Description now states this conflict explicitly per anti-hallucination policy rather than asserting either origin.

Re-audited 2026-08-23: Corrected atoll from North to South (NE corner near Delsan Wreck/Black Rock) -- multiple independent sources agree Ko-ok is on South Atoll. Rewrote description: sources consistently describe Ko-ok as a calm macro/coral-garden site (frogfish, pygmy seahorses, nudibranchs, cleaner shrimp, porcelain crabs), contrasting with the big-animal wall dives -- previous markdown incorrectly framed it as a high-shark-density wall site with generic 'iconic Tubbataha' padding not specific to this site.

Re-audited 2026-08-23: South Atoll confirmed correct (multiple independent sources: thediveglobe.com, divescover.com, dive-the-world.com, Discovery Fleet). 'Disneyland' nickname and 'The Cut' crevasse (30m x 20m, depth to 40m) corroborated by philippinediveholidays.com and searchable dive databases; 40m depth confirmed correct via The Cut, not the wreck itself (wreck is shallow/partly surface-exposed per divescover.com). Corrected framing: the small grounded freighter is a navigational marker/entry point, not the main attraction -- the shark-filled crevasse is.
